aoc_hyw.310.conditions: On its first monthly check with Maine under English protection, the Hundred Years’ War journal schedules this decision for six months later. Maine must still be an English subject when the event fires.

aoc_hyw.311.conditions: England agrees to surrender Maine in The Surrender of Maine. France receives this event when it annexes Maine.

aoc_hyw.312.conditions: England refuses to surrender Maine while Maine is still under English protection.
